【原视频简介】
@MakeGold Did you know that electricity can be used to recover gold from certain gold-bearing solutions? Electrochemical techniques, often called electrowinning or electrolytic recovery, use an electrical current to help deposit dissolved metal onto an electrode.

In this video, we explore the fascinating principle behind recovering gold from solution using electricity and show why electrochemical technology is important in precious-metal recovery and refining.

⚡ Recovering gold using electrical current
💎 Gold recovery from gold-bearing solutions
🔬 Understanding electrolysis and electrowinning
♻️ Precious-metal recovery and recycling
✨ Watch electrochemical gold recovery in action

The effectiveness of the process depends on the solution chemistry, concentration, electrode system, and other operating conditions. Other dissolved metals may also deposit, so the recovered material is not necessarily pure gold without further refining.

⚠️ Safety: Gold-bearing solutions can contain corrosive chemicals, toxic dissolved metals, and may produce hazardous gases under electrolysis. Professional equipment, ventilation, PPE, electrical safety measures, and proper hazardous-waste treatment are essential.
